title: Who it serves, and how it pays
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: who the utility serves, what they need, what it offers, and how each offering pays, drawn on two canvases before anything else.
howto: Paper notes on a wall are drafts; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side. Pink notes are pains, green notes gains.
